picker.none: No one found with that name.

stepHelp.about: Give your idea a clear name and say where it belongs.
stepHelp.problem: Describe the problem before the solution. Judges score how real and painful it is.
stepHelp.solution: Explain what you want to do, in simple words.
stepHelp.value: Say what will improve and how you will measure it.
stepHelp.team: Name the people, the sponsor and any risks.
stepHelp.submit: Add files and links, check the preview, then submit.

form.pageSubtitle: Six short steps. Your work is saved as you type.
form.previewHelp: This is what judges will read.
form.offline: You're offline. Changes will save when you reconnect.
form.lockedTitle: This idea can't be edited now
form.lockedBody: A submitted idea is locked. If something must change, ask the innovation office to return it to you.

fields.title: Idea title
fields.titleHelp: A short name people will remember, for example "QR tracking for packing bags".
fields.forColleagueHelp: Use this for staff without a company login. Your colleague is the owner and gets the credit.
fields.colleagueHelp: Search by name. You see name and department only.
fields.orgUnitHelp: The SBU this idea belongs to.
fields.typeHelp: Any kind counts — it does not have to be IT.
fields.problemHelp: What goes wrong, how often, and what it costs. Good example: "Bags go missing about 40 times a month."
fields.affectedHelp: Teams, roles or customers who feel the problem.
fields.currentProcessHelp: How the work is done today, with any numbers you have.
fields.solutionHelp: What you will change and how it works.
fields.summaryHelp: One or two sentences. Left empty, we use the start of your proposal.
fields.technologyHelp: Tools, equipment or methods. A checklist or a new layout counts too.
fields.differentiatorHelp: How this is better than what we do today.
fields.kpiHelp: The one number that should improve, for example "Hours per report".
fields.baselineHelp: Today's value. Needed before a pilot.
fields.benefitHelp: What improves, by how much, and how you worked it out.
fields.scalabilityHelp: How widely this could be reused.
fields.ownerHelp: Every idea has exactly one accountable owner.
fields.contributorsHelp: Add people who worked on the idea. Credit is split equally unless you set shares.
fields.sharesEqual: Credit will be split equally. Fill in every share to set your own split.
fields.sharesInvalid: Contributor shares must total less than 100% so the owner keeps a share.
fields.sponsorHelp: Optional now. Needed before a pilot can be approved.
fields.risksHelp: Tick all that apply, or None.
fields.classificationHelp: Confidential and Restricted ideas are seen only by a restricted panel.
fields.dependenciesHelp: Systems, data, teams or vendors you depend on.
fields.filesHelp: Documents, screenshots or calculations that support your idea.
fields.filesNeedTitle: Give your idea a title in step 1 first. Then you can add files.
fields.declaration: This is my or my team's original idea, and I have not included secret client or third-party data.
fields.declarationHelp: Ideas made for work belong to the company. You always keep public credit.

done.title: Idea submitted
done.body: The innovation office will check it within 5 working days.

list.subtitle: Your drafts and submitted ideas, with the next step for each.
list.emptyTitle: You haven't shared an idea yet.
list.emptyBody: It takes about 10 minutes. Drafts are saved as you type.
list.deleteBody: "{{title}}" will be removed from your drafts.

detail.actionsOwner: Move your idea forward when it is ready.
detail.actionsStaff: Every decision is recorded with your name and the time.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.emptyBody: Every idea gets written feedback after review, including ideas that are not selected.

impact.emptyBody: A primary KPI with baseline and target is needed before a pilot.

milestones.title: Milestone
milestones.emptyBody: Break the prototype or pilot into a few dated steps.

comments.title: Comments
comments.subtitle: Notes between the idea team and the innovation office.
comments.reviewersOnlyToggle: Only reviewers can see this comment

actions.moves: {{code}} will move to "{{state}}". The owner is notified.
actions.commentRequired: Write a short reason. It is shared with the idea owner.
actions.duplicateHelp: The two ideas are linked; nothing is deleted.
actions.duplicateRequired: Enter the earlier idea's Innovation ID.
actions.missingTitle: This step needs the following first

staff.assignHelp: Choose judges. Anyone with a conflict of interest is blocked automatically.
staff.blockedTitle: Not assigned because of a conflict of interest

conflict.MANAGER: reports to someone on the team

staff.askHelp: The owner is notified and the review clock pauses until they reply.
staff.question: Question
staff.publishHelp: Other teams will be able to find and reuse this innovation.
staff.inCatalogue: This idea is in the innovation catalogue.
staff.impactSummaryHelp: One sentence with the verified result.
staff.reviewsHelp: Judges' names are shown to the innovation office only.

impact.title: Impact
impact.subtitle: Baseline, target and actual results. A value counts as verified only after a verifier confirms it.
impact.emptyTitle: None of your ideas is in prototype, pilot or production yet.
impact.emptyBody: Impact tracking starts once an idea is shortlisted and building begins.
impact.noKpis: No KPIs yet. Add a primary KPI with baseline and target.
impact.queueEmptyBody: New measurements appear here when owners record them.
impact.addKpiHelp: One number that shows the idea works.

fields.noteHelp: Say where the number comes from.

catalogue.title: Innovation catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Implemented innovations you can reuse. Contact the owner to adopt one.
catalogue.emptyTitle: The catalogue is empty for now.
catalogue.emptyBody: Innovations appear here once they are implemented and published.
catalogue.noMatchBody: Try another word or clear the type filter.

results.title: Results and hall of fame
results.subtitle: Published results only. Winners are shown with their title, team and a short summary.
results.emptyBody: Results appear here after the jury decides and the results are approved.
results.summaryHidden: This challenge does not publish winner summaries.
results.hallSubtitle: Innovations that are live and creating value.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your details, skills and recognition.
profile.readOnlyNote: These details come from HR and can't be changed here.
profile.skillsHelp: Skills help teams find you and match reviewers.
profile.languageHelp: The app and your notifications use this language.
profile.notificationNote: Deadline and decision alerts are always sent and can't be turned off.
profile.recognitionHelp: Points and badges are given for quality steps, never for the number of ideas.
profile.emptyBody: Join a challenge or share an idea. Badges come when your work is shortlisted, piloted or verified.
